recipes.name: Moussaka
recipes.description: Layered eggplant, spiced beef and béchamel baked until bronzed.

steps.instruction: Roast eggplant; brown beef with aromatics into thick sauce.
Layer potato-eggplant-meat twice; top with béchamel.
Bake 180°C 50 min; rest 30 min before cutting.

recipes.name: Beef Stifado
recipes.description: Pearl-onion red-wine beef stew perfumed with cinnamon and allspice.

steps.instruction: Marinate beef in wine/vinegar 2+ hours; pat dry, brown.
Add marinade, tomatoes, spices; braise 90 minutes.
Blanched pearl onions in; cook 40 more till jammy.

videos.videoTitle: Stifado - Beef Stifado Recipe - Greek Beef Stew by Theo Michaels, Masterchef

recipes.name: Pastitsio
recipes.description: Greek lasagna: tubular pasta, cinnamon meat sauce, nutmeg béchamel cap.

steps.instruction: Parboil pasta; make cinnamon meat ragu.
Layer pasta-meat-pasta-béchamel; cheese over.
Bake 180°C ~45 min; rest well before slicing.

recipes.name: Yiouvetsi (Beef with Kritharaki)
recipes.description: Beef braised until the orzo drinks every drop of tomato-cinnamon broth.

steps.instruction: Brown beef with onion; add tomatoes, spice, water.
Simmer 90 minutes until nearly tender.
Stir in orzo; bake/steam 25 min absorbed; cheese on top.

videos.videoTitle: The Secret to the Best Youvetsi: A Greek Grandma's Recipe

recipes.name: Chicken Souvlaki
recipes.description: Lemon-oregano chicken skewers wrapped in pita with tzatziki.

steps.instruction: Marinate cubes 2+ hours; skewer.
Grill hot ~12 minutes turning.
Wrap in grilled pita with tzatziki and salads.

recipes.name: Chicken Gyros
recipes.description: Stacked marinated chicken shaved thin, fries inside the pita - Greek way.

steps.instruction: Marinate overnight; stack onto skewer loaf.
Roast vertical-ish at 190°C 50 min, shaving edges.
Fill pitas: gyros, tzatziki, tomato, chips.

recipes.name: Kotopoulo Skorthato
recipes.description: Golden lemon-garlic roast chicken with potatoes in its juices.

steps.instruction: Tuck garlic under skin; season with oregano.
Roast with potatoes at 195°C 75 min, basting lemon-oil-stock.
Rest; spoon pan juices over.

recipes.name: Kotopoulo Lemonato
recipes.description: Skillet lemon chicken with bright avgolemono-style pan sauce.

steps.instruction: Season; sear chicken golden both sides.
Add garlic, broth, lemon; simmer 10 minutes covered.
Reduce glossy; finish with oregano.

recipes.name: Horiatiki (Greek Salad)
recipes.description: Tomato, cucumber, olives, onion and a slab of feta under dried oregano - no lettuce allowed.

steps.instruction: Season vegetables; toss gently with oil.
Top with whole feta slab; oregano snowfall.
More oil; serve with bread for juice mopping.

videos.videoTitle: Greek Salad Recipe | How to Make Greek Salad

recipes.name: Spanakopita
recipes.description: Spinach-feta-herb pie in shattering phyllo layers.

steps.instruction: Mix dry spinach with crumbled feta, herbs, eggs.
Line pan with 8 oiled phyllo; fill; cap with 8 more.
Score; bake 175°C 50 min until deep gold.

recipes.name: Fasolada
recipes.description: Ancient white-bean-tomato soup, Greece's national comfort.

steps.instruction: Simmer beans till tender (~60 min).
Add vegetables, tomatoes, oil; cook 20 more.
Season boldly; finish with raw olive oil drizzle.

videos.videoTitle: FASOLADA — GREECE’S NATIONAL DISH (TRADITIONAL GREEK BEAN SOUP) 🇬🇷

recipes.name: Gigantes Plaki
recipes.description: Giant beans baked in sweet tomato-dill sauce until creamy.

steps.instruction: Parboil beans 30 minutes; drain.
Make tomato sauce with onions/garlic/herbs.
Combine; bake covered 170°C ~1 hour till buttery.

recipes.name: Loukoumades
recipes.description: Honey doughnut puffs with cinnamon and crushed walnuts.

steps.instruction: Beat batter; rise 1 hour till bubbly.
Drop rings of dough into 180°C oil; fry deep gold.
Soak seconds in syrup; walnut-cinnamon dust.

recipes.name: Galaktoboureko
recipes.description: Semolina custard wrapped in crisp phyllo, soaked in lemon syrup.

steps.instruction: Cook thick custard; cool slightly.
Roll custard logs in phyllo; butter each fold; arrange snuggly.
Bake 170°C 50 min; cold syrup immediately over.

recipes.name: Bifteki
recipes.description: Hand-formed Greek beef patties stuffed with feta and oregano.

steps.instruction: Season beef with oregano, garlic, salt and pepper.
Shape into thick patties, pressing feta into center.
Grill over medium-high heat 5 minutes each side until charred.

recipes.name: Stifado
recipes.description: Slow-braised beef with pearl onions, cinnamon and red wine.

steps.instruction: Brown beef in batches; set aside.
Saute onions; add wine, vinegar, tomatoes, spices.
Return beef; simmer covered 2 hours until fork-tender.

recipes.name: Yiouvetsi
recipes.description: Beef and kritharaki orzo in cinnamon-spiced tomato broth.

steps.instruction: Brown beef with onion; add tomatoes, spice, and water.
Simmer covered 90 minutes until nearly tender.
Stir in orzo; cook uncovered 20 minutes until absorbed; top with cheese.

recipes.name: Keftedes
recipes.description: Crispy Greek meatballs seasoned with mint and cinnamon.

steps.instruction: Mix beef with soaked bread, onion, egg, mint, cinnamon, salt and pepper.
Form small balls; dust lightly in flour.
Shallow-fry in olive oil until golden brown all over.

recipes.name: Pastitsio ala Polita
recipes.description: Istanbul-style pastitsio with spiced lamb and tubular pasta.

steps.instruction: Brown lamb with spices; make thick tomato ragu.
Cook pasta al dente; drain.
Layer pasta, meat, bechamel; cheese on top; 180C 40 minutes.

recipes.name: Beef Giouvetsi
recipes.description: Hearty beef chunks braised with tomato and orzo in a clay pot.

steps.instruction: Sear beef cubes; deglaze with wine.
Add tomatoes, cinnamon, water; simmer 90 minutes.
Add orzo to pot; cook until al dente; finish with grated cheese.

recipes.name: Soutzoukakia Smyrneika
recipes.description: Elongated beef meatballs in a fragrant tomato-wine sauce from Smyrna.

steps.instruction: Shape beef into torpedo shapes with garlic, cumin, cinnamon, bread crumbs and egg.
Brown in olive oil; remove.
Simmer tomatoes and wine; return meatballs; cook 30 minutes gently.

recipes.name: Kontosouvli
recipes.description: Greek slow-roasted pork on the spit seasoned with lemon and oregano.

steps.instruction: Marinate pork in lemon, oregano, garlic, paprika, oil for 4 hours.
Thread onto large skewer; tie with wire.
Slow-roast over charcoal 2 hours, basting with marinade.

recipes.name: Beef Gyros
recipes.description: Thinly sliced seasoned beef served in pita with fresh toppings.

steps.instruction: Toss beef slices in spice mix and oil; marinate 2 hours.
Cook in hot skillet in batches until caramelized edges.
Serve in warm pita with tzatziki, tomato, onion.

recipes.name: Paidakia
recipes.description: Grilled lamb chops rubbed with lemon, garlic and oregano.

steps.instruction: Rub chops with garlic, lemon, oregano, oil, salt.
Let rest 30 minutes at room temperature.
Grill over high charcoal 3 to 4 minutes per side for medium.

recipes.name: Arni Kokkinisto
recipes.description: Lamb braised low and slow in a rich cinnamon-tomato sauce.

steps.instruction: Brown lamb in batches; saute onion until golden.
Add wine, tomatoes, cinnamon, garlic; return lamb.
Braise covered at 160C for 2 hours until falling apart.

recipes.name: Stifatho
recipes.description: Traditional Cretan beef stew with pearl onions and honey-vinegar glaze.

steps.instruction: Brown beef; add vinegar to deglaze.
Add tomatoes, honey, spices, and enough water to cover.
Simmer 90 minutes; add pearl onions; cook 30 more.

recipes.name: Greek Burger
recipes.description: Beef burger patty with feta, oregano and sun-dried tomato.

steps.instruction: Mix beef with feta, tomatoes, oregano, garlic.
Form 4 thick patties; grill 4 to 5 minutes per side.
Serve on buns with lettuce, tomato, and tzatziki.

recipes.name: Lamb Chops Greek-Style
recipes.description: Thick-cut lamb chops marinated in lemon and herbs then charcoal-grilled.

steps.instruction: Marinate chops in lemon, garlic, herbs, oil 2 hours.
Preheat grill to high.
Grill 3 minutes per side; rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Beef Gyro Plate
recipes.description: Seasoned beef slices served over pita with tzatziki and fresh vegetables.

steps.instruction: Toss beef in spice mix; marinate 1 hour.
Sear in very hot skillet in batches.
Layer pita, beef, tzatziki, tomato, onion.

recipes.name: Kotopoulo Kokkinisto
recipes.description: Chicken braised in cinnamon-scented tomato sauce, Greek comfort classic.

steps.instruction: Brown chicken pieces; remove.
Saute onion and garlic; add tomatoes and cinnamon.
Return chicken; simmer covered 45 minutes until tender.

recipes.name: Kota Yiachni
recipes.description: Lemon-chicken stew finished with creamy avgolemono egg sauce.

steps.instruction: Simmer chicken with onion and water until tender.
Strain broth; return chicken.
Whisk eggs with lemon; slowly temper with hot broth; pour over chicken.

recipes.name: Giapoyla
recipes.description: Spatchcocked chicken grilled over charcoal with mountain herbs and lemon.

steps.instruction: Butterfly chicken; flatten firmly.
Rub with lemon, garlic, herbs, oil.
Grill skin-side down over medium charcoal 20 minutes; flip and finish.

recipes.name: Kritharaki Poulo
recipes.description: Chicken thighs baked with orzo in a tomato-cinnamon broth.

steps.instruction: Brown chicken; remove.
Saute onion; add tomatoes, cinnamon, water.
Add orzo and chicken; 180C 25 minutes; cheese on top.

recipes.name: Koulourakia Tou Kamilariou
recipes.description: Savory Greek twisted biscuits enriched with chicken broth.

steps.instruction: Mix flour, broth, butter, eggs, and anise into smooth dough.
Roll into ropes; twist into traditional shapes.
Brush with egg wash, sprinkle sesame; 180C 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Chicken Stifado
recipes.description: Chicken thigh stew with pearl onions in cinnamon-red wine sauce.

steps.instruction: Brown chicken pieces; set aside.
Saute onions; deglaze with wine.
Add tomatoes, spices, chicken; simmer 40 minutes.

recipes.name: Poula Kokkinisto
recipes.description: Whole chicken pieces braised in herbed tomato broth with potatoes.

steps.instruction: Brown chicken; remove.
Saute onion; add tomatoes, oregano.
Add potatoes and chicken; simmer covered 40 minutes.

recipes.name: Chicken Pita
recipes.description: Grilled chicken breast in pita with tomato, onion and mustard sauce.

steps.instruction: Season chicken with paprika and oregano.
Grill 5 to 6 minutes per side; slice.
Stuff warm pita with chicken, tomato, onion, sauce.

recipes.name: Afelia
recipes.description: Chicken pieces slowly braised in coriander seed and red wine.

steps.instruction: Toast and crush coriander seeds.
Brown chicken; remove.
Braise onion and garlic in oil; add wine, coriander, chicken; simmer 45 minutes.

recipes.name: Youvetsi Poulo
recipes.description: Chicken baked with orzo in tomato sauce until the grains drink every drop.

steps.instruction: Brown chicken with onion.
Add tomatoes, cinnamon, water; simmer 30 minutes.
Add orzo; 180C 20 minutes; cheese on top.

recipes.name: Kotosoupa
recipes.description: Traditional Greek chicken avgolemono soup with rice and dill.

steps.instruction: Boil chicken with carrot and celery until cooked through.
Remove chicken; add rice to broth.
Whisk eggs with lemon; slowly temper with broth; return shredded chicken.

recipes.name: Poulet Kaserolaki
recipes.description: Greek chicken casserole with tomatoes, peppers and crumbled feta.

steps.instruction: Brown chicken; remove.
Saute peppers and onion; add tomatoes.
Return chicken; top with feta; 180C 35 minutes.

recipes.name: Chicken Lemonato
recipes.description: Pan-seared chicken finished in a bright lemon-butter pan sauce.

steps.instruction: Season and sear chicken golden both sides.
Add garlic, broth, lemon; simmer 10 minutes.
Swirl in butter; finish with oregano and lemon zest.

recipes.name: Miso Chicken Greek-Style
recipes.description: White-miso and lemon-marinated chicken grilled over charcoal.

steps.instruction: Whisk miso, lemon, honey, garlic, oil into marinade.
Marinate chicken 2 hours.
Grill over high heat 5 to 6 minutes per side until caramelized.

recipes.name: Spanakorizo
recipes.description: Hearty spinach rice simmered with dill, lemon and olive oil.

steps.instruction: Saute onion in olive oil until soft.
Add spinach; wilt; add rice and water.
Simmer 18 minutes; finish with lemon and dill; feta on top.

recipes.name: Briam
recipes.description: Rustic Greek roasted vegetable medley drenched in olive oil.

steps.instruction: Layer vegetables in a deep tray.
Season generously; pour olive oil and tomatoes over.
Roast 180C 75 minutes until golden and collapsed.

recipes.name: Fava Santorini
recipes.description: Silky yellow split pea puree from Santorini topped with capers and onion.

steps.instruction: Rinse split peas; simmer with onion and water 40 minutes.
Blend smooth with lemon and oil.
Serve with capers, red onion rings and olive oil.

recipes.name: Horta
recipes.description: Blanched wild greens dressed with olive oil and fresh lemon.

steps.instruction: Wash greens thoroughly; boil in salted water 10 minutes.
Drain well; chop roughly.
Dress with olive oil, lemon, vinegar, garlic.

recipes.name: Horiatiki
recipes.description: Traditional Greek village salad with thick feta, olives and oregano.

steps.instruction: Arrange tomatoes, cucumber, onion on plate.
Top with whole feta slab and olives.
Drizzle olive oil; shower with dried oregano.

recipes.name: Melitzanosalata
recipes.description: Smoky charred eggplant dip whipped with garlic, olive oil and lemon.

steps.instruction: Char eggplants directly over flame until collapsed.
Peel; drain liquid; chop flesh.
Mix with garlic, lemon, oil, parsley, vinegar.

recipes.name: Taramosalata
recipes.description: Silky fish roe dip blended with bread and olive oil.

steps.instruction: Soak bread in water; squeeze dry.
Blend tarama with lemon and onion until pale.
Stream in oil; fold in bread until smooth.

recipes.name: Fakies
recipes.description: Thick Greek red lentil soup with cumin and a squeeze of lemon.

steps.instruction: Saute onion and carrot; add cumin.
Add lentils, tomatoes, water; simmer 25 minutes.
Blend partially; finish with lemon and olive oil.

recipes.name: Revithada
recipes.description: Slow-baked chickpea stew from Sifnos with bay and lemon.

steps.instruction: Drain soaked chickpeas; place in clay pot.
Add onion, bay, rosemary, oil, water to cover.
Cover tightly; 160C 3 hours until melting.

recipes.name: Fasolakia
recipes.description: Green beans braised in olive oil and tomato.

steps.instruction: Saute onion until translucent.
Add beans, tomatoes, oil, potatoes, water.
Simmer covered 40 minutes until very tender.

recipes.name: Kolokithakia
recipes.description: Baby zucchini braised in tomato sauce with fresh mint and dill.

steps.instruction: Saute onion and garlic in olive oil.
Add zucchini, tomatoes, water.
Simmer 25 minutes until soft; finish with herbs.

recipes.name: Fasolakia Ladera
recipes.description: Olive oil-braised green beans and tomatoes.

steps.instruction: Saute onion until soft.
Add beans, tomatoes, garlic, oil, sugar, water.
Simmer uncovered 45 minutes until rich and concentrated.

recipes.name: Yemista
recipes.description: Tomatoes and bell peppers stuffed with herbed rice and pine nuts.

steps.instruction: Saute onion; add rice, pine nuts, herbs, oil.
Stuff vegetables with rice mixture.
Add water to tray; 180C 60 minutes.

recipes.name: Manitaria
recipes.description: Greek-style wild mushrooms sauteed with garlic, wine and herbs.

steps.instruction: Saute mushrooms in hot oil without crowding.
Add garlic and thyme; cook 1 minute.
Deglaze with wine; finish with lemon and parsley.

recipes.name: Prasorizo
recipes.description: Greek leek and rice pilaf with tomato and fresh herbs.

steps.instruction: Saute leeks in olive oil until very soft.
Add tomatoes, rice, water.
Simmer 18 minutes until rice is tender; fold in herbs and lemon.

recipes.name: Kataifi
recipes.description: Shredded pastry rolled around walnuts and soaked in cinnamon syrup.

steps.instruction: Toss kataifi shreds in melted butter.
Spread; sprinkle walnut-cinnamon filling.
Roll into log; 170C 35 minutes; drench in cold syrup.

recipes.name: Karydopita
recipes.description: Moist walnut cake soaked in spiced lemon syrup.

steps.instruction: Beat eggs with sugar until pale.
Fold in walnuts, flour, butter, baking powder.
175C 35 minutes; soak in warm syrup.

recipes.name: Galaktoboureko Trachanas
recipes.description: Semolina custard wrapped in phyllo with a tangy twist.

steps.instruction: Cook thick semolina custard with milk, eggs, sugar.
Roll custard in buttered phyllo sheets.
175C 45 minutes; cold syrup over hot.

recipes.name: Melomakarona
recipes.description: Honey-soaked semolina-orange cookies crowned with walnut crumbs.

steps.instruction: Mix semolina, flour, oil, orange into dough.
Shape oval cookies; 175C 20 minutes.
Dip hot cookies in cold honey syrup; walnut-cinnamon topping.

recipes.name: Koulourakia
recipes.description: Classic Greek Easter butter cookies twisted into braids.

steps.instruction: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs, vanilla, zest.
Fold in flour and baking powder.
Shape into twists; egg wash and sesame; 175C 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Sfakianopita
recipes.description: Thin Cretan cheese pie drizzled with honey.

steps.instruction: Make elastic dough with flour, oil, juice.
Roll thin; fill with mizithra; fold into round.
Cook on hot griddle both sides; honey drizzle.

recipes.name: Amygdalota
recipes.description: Delicate Greek almond macaroons scented with rosewater.

steps.instruction: Beat egg whites to soft peaks with sugar.
Fold in almond flour, rosewater, zest.
Form rounds; press almond on top; 160C 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Giouvetsi
recipes.description: Orzo pasta baked with chicken in tomato sauce

steps.instruction: Brown chicken pieces.
Add tomato sauce, onion, and cinnamon.
Add orzo and water.
Bake at 180C until orzo absorbs sauce and chicken is cooked.

recipes.name: Arni Kokkinisto Kleftiko
recipes.description: Braised lamb in tomato and cinnamon

steps.instruction: Brown lamb pieces.
Sauté onion and garlic.
Add tomato sauce, wine, and cinnamon.
Braise until tender.

recipes.name: Kotopoulo Kokkinisto Sfacto
recipes.description: Braised chicken in tomato sauce

steps.instruction: Brown chicken pieces.
Sauté onion and garlic.
Add tomato sauce and oregano.
Braise until chicken is tender.

recipes.name: Fasolakia Ladera Saltsa
recipes.description: Green beans in olive oil and tomato

steps.instruction: Trim beans.
Sauté onion.
Add tomatoes and beans.
Braise until tender.

recipes.name: Portokalopita
recipes.description: Orange phyllo cake soaked in syrup

steps.instruction: Crumble phyllo and let dry.
Mix eggs, sugar, yogurt, orange juice, and baking powder.
Pour over phyllo.
Bake at 180C for 40 minutes, pour syrup on top.
